ARCS kitMolecule 68spec-rows

Spec Rows

Name a few labelled choices and what each one covers, as hairline rows in running text or as side-by-side cards (two or three across) when the reader is meant to pick.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1RowLabel column and definition, split by hairlinesborder
2LabelSemibold; in the cards variant, mono uppercase cyan with a dottext, cyan
3DefinitionSecondary text, wraps prettytext-secondary
4Cards variant.spec.cards: each row a surface card, two columns, stacking on a phonesurface, border, ds-r-md
5Three-up variant.spec.cards.is-3: three cards in one row from 760px; one column below that, so a third card never orphans under twosurface, border, ds-r-md

Usage

Use it when

  • Two to four named options, each needing a sentence of scope.
  • Cards when the reader is asked to choose; rows when the labels only define terms.

Do not use it when

  • Do not use it for a single inline term; that is 50 Term Definition.
  • Do not put prices or terms in a card; those belong in 41 Offer Close.
  • Do not use is-3 with two or four rows; two cards take the plain cards variant.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
rows[]{label, text}yesTwo to four.
variantrows | cards | cards is-3noDefault rows. is-3 only with exactly three rows.

Access

  • A real dl with dt and dd, so a screen reader pairs each label with its definition.
  • The cards variant's dot is decorative (generated content); the label text carries the meaning.
  • Grid tracks use minmax(0, 1fr); long text wraps inside the card.
